description: Farther on Down the Road: Transport Costs, Trade and Urban Growth is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Replication Data for Adam Storeygard; Farther on down the Road: Transport Costs, Trade and Urban Growth in Sub-Saharan Africa, The Review of Economic Studies, Volume 83, Issue 3, 1 July 2016, Pages 1263–1295,. Abstract: How does isolation affect the economic activity of cities? Coverage: the whole world. It has 3 files in PDF, ZIP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
